line.devoted: In {settlement} they bow at dusk and bring the first of the harvest.
line.fearful: In {settlement} they watch the sky and speak quietly.
line.restless: In {settlement} they murmur against the god.
line.defiant: In {settlement} they raise their fists at the sky.

person.defiant: {name} raises a fist at the sky

remember.patience: the long quiet of the god

opening.sea: The waters gathered into a sea.
opening.rain: Rain fell on the bare rock.
opening.life: Green came up out of the wet ground.
opening.forest: Forests stood where nothing had stood.
opening.none: The world was made, and waited.

fall: The Fall of the Tower of {town}
builders: The Age of the Tower of {town}
The Years of the Standing Tower
brokenvow: The Age of the Broken Promise
defiance: The Years of Stones Against the Sky
dread: The Years of Watching the Sky
silence: The Years the God Was Still

open.making: The world was made, and no one yet stood on it to see.
open.plenty: At {town} they had bread, and the god was near.
open.proud: The granaries were full, and they stood taller.
open.scattering: At {town} they had one speech, and built.
open.fall: At {town} the tower stood, until it fell.
open.warning: A voice came to the builders at {town}.
open.builders: At {town} the tower was finished, and it stood.
open.covenant: After the ruin the survivors looked to the sky, and the god bound itself.
open.brokenvow: The god had promised, and the promise broke.
open.defiance: They stopped bowing, and raised their fists.
open.dread: They watched the sky, and were afraid.
open.trust: They asked, and waited, and were not let down.
open.silence: The god said nothing, year after year.
open.wandering: Many left their homes and took the road.
open.golden: {town} grew in number, wealth and knowledge.

again: As in {earlier}, it came without warning.
plentyEnd: And the years of plenty ended, when {cause}.

godPart.sign: The god answered with a sign.

people.fear: They were a people of fear: they bowed, and did not love.
people.trust: They were a people of trust: they asked, and waited, and were not often let down.
people.pride: They were a proud people: they built to be seen.
people.defiance: They were a people who answered back.
people.faith: They were a faithful people: at dusk they bowed.
people.forgetting: They were a people who forgot: the god became a story told to children.
people.many-minds: They were many peoples, and did not agree about their god.

god.wrath: Their god was quick to anger.
god.mercy: Their god struck, and then healed.
god.patience: Their god watched, and waited, and seldom struck.

closing.wrath: The story is not finished. What will the god do next?
closing.wonders: The story is not finished. What will the god do next?
closing.silence: The story is not finished. They are still waiting to see.
closing.patience: The story is not finished. They are still waiting to see.
closing.mercy: The story is not finished. They are still waiting to see.
closing.faithfulness: The story is not finished. The promise holds.

note: What came before is remembered only in the chronicle.

drowned.name: the One Who Drowned the World

keeper.name: the One Who Keeps Its Word

generations.scatter: From the scattering at {town} came {children}, who speak apart.
generations.apart: , who no longer speak as their mothers did

promise.kept: After {after} the god promised {who} {says}. It has kept that promise {years}.
promise.broken: After {after} the god promised {who} {says}. It broke that promise in year {year}.
promise.fresh: After {after} the god promised {who} {says}. The bow has not yet been seen.

nextCall: And then came the time they call {name}.

flood: The water came to {place} and took {count} of them.
At {place} the river rose in the night and took {count} of them.
fire: Fire came to {place} and took {count} of them.
ruin: The ground broke under {place}, and {count} were lost.
strike: Fire came down on the {tower} at {place}, and {count} died under it.
confuse: At {place} they built the {tower}, and {god} broke their speech.
tower: At {place} they built the {tower} to be seen from far away.
covenant: After the ruin {god} set a bow over {place} and promised.
kept: {god} kept its promise to {place}, year after year.
warn: A prophet told the builders at {place} to go home, and they went.
silence: The {tower} at {place} was finished, and {god} said nothing.
answer: {place} shouted at the sky, and {god} answered.
defiance: At {place} they threw stones at the sky.
firstwrong: Once {god} walked near, until the first wrong.
wandering: Our people took the road, and {god} went with us.
othergods: They turned to other gods, and {god} let them go.

legendCause.patience: , and the god let them be, and watched

legendHeart.defiant: {tale} The god feared what we could do.
